beats.vo_text: Ye kahani kisi social media afwaah par nahi, balki Archaeological Survey of India ka Section 19 Ancient Monuments Act board par darj hai. Lekin 1573 mein Raja Madho Singh, Princess Ratnavati aur Tantrik Singhia ke sath ek aisi ghatna ghati jisne is poore ilaaqe ki taqdeer badal di.

beats.vo_text: Sabse khaufnaak hadsa tab report hua jab 2010 mein do trekkers outer boundary cross karke andar ruke the, subah unka backpack Johri Bazaar ke khandar mein mila jismein aakhri recorded audio sirf 14 second ki thi — patthar par lohe ke drag hone ki aawaz aur rone ki cheekh! Chashmadeedo ke mutabiq unhone deewar par dekha ki sadiyon purana ek saya bina zameen ko chhue tezi se unki taraf badh raha tha! Unhone cheekh kar kaha: 'Wo deewar se nahi nikla... deewar hi uska chehra ban chuki thi!' — aur unke paas wahan se bhaagne ke siva koi rasta nahi bacha tha!
